summary: Approved exact current commit 658bc7b49cc5ef1179d41f8e9f2c8492ed3f9a62 with no unresolved blocking security finding. The only application/tooling source delta since the prior approval is b0eb18382b290987f9f95d791fa26f6b087e79e9, which makes requirements-agent.txt include the existing backend/requirements.txt manifest; later commits refresh tester/verification evidence and lifecycle status only. Commit-bound verification remains current for 4257a8ea5fccb565ab3dce316c4fa7b5c7ee9107 because the reviewed HEAD differs from it only by verification-report metadata and task status. The include keeps one authoritative set of exact direct backend pins, resolves compatibly with the existing pytest tooling constraint, introduces no new package declaration, runtime code path, credential, workflow permission, deployment, database, frontend, production, or real-PHI surface, and allows the unchanged least-privilege CI workflow to exercise the actual backend. Independent clean-environment evidence installed requirements-agent.txt alone, followed the backend include, passed pip check, then passed project/task/report schemas, OpenAPI, 12 agentic tests, 43 backend tests, and the tracked-secret baseline without loading .env or invoking live Vertex AI. This security re-review independently reran all 43 backend and 12 agentic tests credential-free, OpenAPI/task validation, pip consistency and exact direct-version checks, ignored/tracked-secret checks, diff hygiene, and approved source hashes. All previously approved fixed-path, bounded exact-Decimal, canonical REPEAT evidence, strict structured-output/citation, sanitized-error, source-immutability, local-only unauthenticated, one-call/no-tools/thinking-disabled Gemini, safe-wording, and no-production/no-real-PHI boundaries remain unchanged. PR #2's merge commit db51ee0 contains the reviewed b0eb183 source fix; the security review target remains the exact local evidence commit recorded above. The two prior low-risk defense-in-depth findings remain non-blocking.

findings.description: The fixed safety instruction and JSON-serialized untrusted synthetic facts are delimited but concatenated into the same SDK user-content string; the SDK's dedicated system_instruction field is not used.
findings.impact: A maliciously replaced repository dataset string could compete with the instruction and influence candidate wording. The practical impact is constrained because the endpoint has fixed local inputs, the model has no tools or side effects, output is bounded and candidate-only, citations are allowlisted, and deterministic limitations remain authoritative.
findings.remediation: As defense in depth, place the fixed instruction in GenerateContentConfig.system_instruction, send only the labeled serialized data as user content, and add an adversarial test that asserts instruction/data role separation while preserving the no-tools and no-environment-value guarantees.

findings.description: CI now includes the exact-pinned direct backend manifest through requirements-agent.txt, and the installed/clean-test environments pass pip check, but the repository still does not lock the complete transitive graph with artifact hashes or configure a dedicated vulnerability audit check; agentic-only packages also remain bounded range pins.
findings.impact: A future clean CI or local installation can resolve different transitive artifacts within allowed ranges, reducing reproducibility and leaving dependency-advisory detection dependent on manual review. The include itself adds no package beyond the existing manifests and exposes no demonstrated vulnerability in the reviewed environments.
findings.remediation: For the next hardening task, generate a reviewed hash-pinned transitive lock and add a required dependency vulnerability audit that fails on unresolved applicable advisories.
